title: Simultaneous EEG and fNIRS recordings for semantic decoding of imagined animals and tools
description: This dataset provides simultaneous EEG and fNIRS recordings from 12 participants performing a silent naming task and three sensory-based imagery tasks (visual, auditory, tactile) on objects from the semantic categories of animals and tools. It supports research on semantic decoding and brain-computer interfacing. Stimulus images and example Python scripts for loading the data with MNE and MNE-BIDS are included.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BioSemi ActiveTwo system (64 electrodes, 10-20 system, earlobe references, GSR and respiration channels) at 2048 Hz. fNIRS was recorded with a NIRx NIRScoutXP continuous-wave system (8 sources, 4 detectors) using frontal and temporal montages, with EEG electrodes and optodes placed in an integrated NIRx cap.
